name: Jubilant Ingrevia Ltd
title: Jubilant Ingrevia Ltd - 543271 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 record revenue Rs 1,179 cr (+12% YoY) and EBITDA Rs 172 cr, with Specialty margin held near 27%; supply-side signals are thin, and acetyls spreads face a likely falling-price headwind after Q1.

utilisation.quote: we run our plants at 90% plus utilization levels

capex.peers_comment: Chinese Pyridine plants run at 30%, 40% utilization levels
capex.quote: we will continue with the range of Rs. 400 crore to Rs. 500 crore of yearly capex

triggers.label: Pyridine capacity 90%+ utilised; China 30-40%
triggers.quote: The plants in China typically run at 30%, 40% utilization levels

triggers.label: Acetic acid prices coming down
triggers.quote: we are already seeing acetic acid prices coming down

triggers.label: European acetyls force majeure
triggers.quote: there were some announcements from European competitors for force majeure for a few weeks

triggers.label: EBITDA growth at least 20% FY27
triggers.quote: we will stick to our overall guidance of achieving at least 20% growth in EBITDA through the year

triggers.label: Agro CDMO volume visibility only for Q1
triggers.quote: So far, they gave us the visibility for first quarter of volumes

guidance.quote: we aspire to get at least 20% year-on-year growth in EBITDA on the full year basis
we will continue with the range of Rs. 400 crore to Rs. 500 crore of yearly capex
the sustainable margin for our Specialty Chemical portfolio as a whole should be between 23% to 25%

guidance.metric: Sequential growth in revenue and EBITDA
guidance.quote: We are expecting a sequential growth in revenue and EBITDA in coming quarters, starting from Q1 FY '27 itself

red_flags.label: Agro CDMO volume visibility only for Q1
red_flags.quote: So far, they gave us the visibility for first quarter of volumes

red_flags.label: Acetyls inventory gains may reverse
red_flags.quote: whatever inventory impact has to come, we will be able to nullify within this quarter

red_flags.label: Pyridine pricing at rock bottom
red_flags.quote: for Pyridine prices, they are very low, in fact, at the rock bottom

evasions.quote: the challenge in giving quarterly growth rates is because one contract moving up and down
they have not confirmed the final volumes yet
it will not be just as linear, as you said
